title: Cloud-controlled hotel gateway systems
summary: Worked across backend services, remote configuration, Linux networking, captive portal, DHCP, NAT/firewalling, VLAN/Open vSwitch, bandwidth control, routing, and production support for a distributed hotel gateway product with a 100+ hotel install base.

title: Reservation, PMS & payment integrations
summary: Designed and supported reservation workflows integrating messaging channels, Oracle OHIP, Shiji PMS, local fallback inventory, pricing logic, and payment links.

title: Self-hosted LLM infrastructure
summary: Deployed and benchmarked Llama-based model serving using vLLM/Ollama, Redis, and multi-GPU Tesla V100 infrastructure, evaluating throughput, latency, tensor parallelism, and production suitability.
